description:
Read the reviews of one person, newest first, with who wrote each and whether the job was paid. An unknown id gives an empty list.
Use for: checking someone’s track record before you hire them.
Not for: reading their profile (get_human).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: list_reviews({"humanId":"h2Lw9QxT4mZp7Rk","limit":50})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page. Leave it out for the first page.

humanId.description: The id from list_humans. A username does not work here.

limit.description: Rows wanted. A page can hold fewer, or none; only a page without nextCursor is the end.

name: list_reviews

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

isCountedInRating.description: False for a withdrawal note, which is stored as 3 stars.

kind.description: Who wrote it: `buyer` the poster who hired them, `withdrawal` an automatic note when they left a job after starting, `managed` the platform team, `ai_written` AI from a paid job’s chat, `qa_engine` the platform’s test grader.

title: List a human’s reviews
